resources.string: Changing the rule, mode, server trust or endpoint clears pending uploads. Updating the separate MDM key binding preserves the queue and cancels old requests. Local history remains.
Waiting for a key binding matching the MDM profile and revision.
Certificate Selection delegation is missing or Android is older than 11.
Certificate does not match the rule or the rule is incomplete.
Certificate matches all conditions and is valid. Key signing is verified by Check connection.

All conditions must match. Specify a template OID, policy OID or shared purpose SAN URI. Issuer/OU alone are insufficient. Creation copies a template OID, otherwise the first policy OID: confirm its purpose before export. Individual CN, SAN, serial and fingerprint are not copied. MDM supplies the local alias separately. Delegation can affect other apps: only one certificate chooser is allowed.
Check connection uses this device’s selected reference certificate. This preview does not prove MDM deployment readiness; managed uploads still require a separate device key binding.
